claims: Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 in the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game in Miami.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game occurred on March 17, 2026.
Pitcher Daniel Palencia locked down the final inning of the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game.
Eugenio Suárez hit a go-ahead RBI double in the ninth inning of the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game.
The final score of the 2026 World Baseball Classic championship game was Venezuela 3, USA 2.
Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic title.
Venezuela is the fourth country to win the World Baseball Classic.
Japan has won the World Baseball Classic.
The Dominican Republic has won the World Baseball Classic.
The USA has won the World Baseball Classic.
